title: Party dimension row (canonical, time-invariant)
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/elections/dim_parties.parquet. One row per party_id. Mirror of the citizen-relevant subset of datasets/taxonomy/parties.json (short_name, full_name, recognition, brand_colour, election_symbol, wikipedia_url); the JSON registry remains the operator-editable source-of-truth, this Parquet table is the frontend-readable canonical view. Sub-phase 1.2b of TODO/20260517-canonical-long-format-pivot.md.

x-changelog.description: Initial dim_parties schema. Columns: party_id PK, eci_code, short_name, full_name, recognition, source_id.

PR-SYM-6b additive. Add 5 nullable mirror columns from taxonomy/parties.json: brand_colour_hex, brand_colour_confidence, wikipedia_url, election_symbol_asset_path, election_symbol_render_mode. Lets the frontend resolver + symbol chip read everything they need from one canonical join (dim_parties) without a second fetch of parties.json. Per ADR-0047 writer-emits-current-version; readers gated on schema-compatibility.json.

eci_code.description: ECI numeric/alpha party code if known. Multiple aliases collapse to one party_id; this carries the primary code only.

short_name.description: Display abbreviation (e.g. 'DMK', 'BJP'). Citizens see this in result tables.

recognition.description: ECI recognition status. Nullable when not yet classified.

brand_colour_hex.description: Wikipedia-sourced brand colour as 6-digit hex. Nullable when not yet sourced. Frontend resolver consumes this as its 'brand' tier when brand_colour_confidence is high or medium.

brand_colour_confidence.description: Confidence in brand_colour_hex. 'low' means faction-split or disputed assignment — resolver MUST skip and fall through to algorithmic fallback per Hans (Governance) verdict.

wikipedia_url.description: Canonical Wikipedia article URL for 'Learn more' affordance. Provenance link for brand_colour and election_symbol.

election_symbol_asset_path.description: Repo-relative asset path under frontend/public/party-symbols/. Mirror of taxonomy/parties.json election_symbol.asset_path.

election_symbol_render_mode.description: Render hint. 'source_coloured' = use asset as-is (already has brand colours baked in). 'recolourable' = monochrome; consumer may tint with brand_colour_hex. 'silhouette' = decorative-only outline.

source_id.description: FK -> taxonomy/sources.parquet. The provenance row for the parties.json registry that seeded this entry.
